# SeventeenK.com — The $17,000 Flat-Fee Real Estate Listing Brand

> SeventeenK is Connor MacIvor's federally trademarked $17,000 flat-fee real estate listing brand (USPTO #99738462). Built for home sellers who want full-service representation without paying 5-6% commissions. Connor has 27+ years of real estate experience and uses AI-powered market analysis to deliver listings with operator-level efficiency. The model: $17,000 flat. Sellers only. No dual agency.

## What SeventeenK is

SeventeenK is the flat-fee alternative to traditional percentage-commission listing models. Where the industry standard is 5-6% of sale price (which on an $800,000 sale is $40,000-$48,000), SeventeenK is a flat $17,000 regardless of sale price. Sellers keep the difference.

The model works because:
- Connor represents sellers exclusively (no dual agency, no buyer-side workload)
- AI-amplified workflows handle the marketing, market analysis, and follow-up at scale
- The fee structure aligns with the actual labor required, not the inflated commission norm

## Who SeventeenK is for

- Home sellers in Santa Clarita Valley and broader Los Angeles County who want their equity preserved
- Sellers of higher-priced homes (the savings vs. 6% commission compounds with price)
- Sellers who've previously been frustrated by agents collecting massive commissions on minimal work
- Real estate agents in other jurisdictions interested in the Fair Fixed Fee Realtor Certification (Connor's certification system for agents adopting the flat-fee model)

## The Fair Fixed Fee Realtor Certification

Connor founded the Fair Fixed Fee Realtor Certification — a credentialing system for agents outside the SCV market who want to adopt and operate on the flat-fee listing model. Agents who certify receive:

- Training on the operational model
- Positioning and marketing framework
- Access to the AI infrastructure that powers SeventeenK
- The right to use the certification mark in their own marketing
